from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CapitalReserveData(BaseModel):
    """Captures the capital reserve information from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the financial data")
    capital_reserve: float | None = Field(description="The capital reserve amount (资本公积) reported in the document")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (e.g., 2025-03-31)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported value (e.g., CNY, Yuan)")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short quote or label from the document for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root schema aggregating all extracted capital reserve records from the document collection."""
    capital_reserve_records: list[CapitalReserveData]
